notes: Merged 'Other caps' (k95) into Baseball cap: New Era/Rapha/Von Dutch/Carhartt models became archetype versions or m entries; attribute names (fitted, snapback, strapback, A-frame, retro crown, trucker) became t types; Ascot cap and Gatsby became Flat cap types. Not placed on this shelf, to be absorbed as types of 'Traditional, ceremonial & uniform headwear' (Hats shelf) per the brief: Kepi, Shako, Patrol cap, Peaked cap, Budenovka, Rogatywka, Student cap, Utility cover, Cricket cap, Kufi, Kofia. Dropped: Bump cap (PPE -> Tools), Sports visor and Green eyeshade (not caps; visor belongs with Sun hat if wanted), wholesale Carhartt cap SKUs. Balaclava and Headband made tier: Amazon-noise brands (BCG, LITAN, MUTU, NANDN, RAUO, RenChill, SHUNWEI, Saffee, Tolasmik, Uhznus) and duplicate Nike/Heat Holders SKUs cut to four market-covering models each; no independent test winner was found for these kinds. Beanie: Carhartt SKU variants collapsed into the A18 archetype; Chullo and Rastacap kept as maker-free archetypes. Years left blank where no retrieved page confirmed them (9FIFTY launch, Lock Gill, Acne Pansy, '47 founding, Buff founding, dUCk founding). Stetson Hatteras sourced from a retailer page because stetson.com/jjhatcenter pages were not accessible; '47 and Ebbets sourced from their own product pages because Wikipedia pages were not accessible. Headscarf: niqab/chador left out as face/body veils rather than headscarves; red-and-white keffiyeh variant omitted as not confirmed by the retrieved page. The wiki tool returned a lock error all session, so Wikipedia pages were retrieved via web_fetch after web_search.
